notas: Centre (origen: mío) = pixel with the highest mean solar illumination (0.8706) of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 within 9-12 km of the IAU centre of Shackleton; reproduce with python -m pipeline.terreno borde. Plane = LOLA south polar stereographic: up = longitude 0°, right = 90° E.
comando: python -m pipeline.terreno generar --id shackleton_borde --cuerpo luna --lat -89.68643 --lon -162.9371 --lado-km 10.0 --n 1024 --escala sitio --nombre 'Shackleton rim, most illuminated point' --centro-fuente https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/MoonIllumination/AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608.TIF --capas iluminacion,sombra_permanente,temp_max --dem ldem_875s_5m --notas 'Centre (origen: mío) = pixel with the highest mean solar illumination (0.8706) of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 within 9-12 km of the IAU centre of Shackleton; reproduce with python -m pipeline.terreno borde.'

picos_luz.criterio: 5 pixels of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (60 m) with the highest mean solar illumination whose centre falls in the grid, greedy, each at least 1 km from the previous ones (polar stereographic plane); fila/col = grid cell containing the pixel centre; valor = pixel value
